name: Programmable supply
description: One channel of a bench power supply. Enabled, it holds the set voltage between its terminals until the load asks for more than the current limit; it then limits the current and lets the voltage fall (constant-voltage to constant-current transition). Its negative terminal must be tied to a reference: the ground rail or any other source.

enabled.description: The channel output. Off, the terminals are left open.

outputVoltage.description: Voltage obtained between the terminals, in volts.

outputCurrent.description: Current delivered by the positive terminal, in amperes.

mode.description: 0: output off, 1: constant voltage, 2: constant current (the limit is reached).
